## Decision notes (verification.yaml)

| Item | Category | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `cohort.inclusion` | documentation_derived | Adults (>=18 years) — provisional; ADA screening guidance and the All of Us adult cohort to be confirmed. |
| `phenotype.case_index_rule` | method_decision | Case index = earliest date the case rule holds (FR-131). |
| `phenotype.case_rule` | documentation_derived | V-21a. Shape follows the eMERGE T2D algorithm (kho_2012_emerge_t2d): combinations of T2D diagnoses, diabetes medications, and an abnormal HbA1c, excluding type 1/other diabetes. Exact counts, code lists, and the HbA1c threshold (6.5% per ada_soc_2026_s2, secondary summaries) are provisional until the PheKB algorithm and the ADA primary text are reviewed. |
| `phenotype.control_rule` | documentation_derived | V-21b. Controls need positive non-diabetic evidence (normal HbA1c <5.7% or normal glucose <100 mg/dL), no diabetes diagnosis, no diabetes medication, no type 1/other diabetes code. Requiring a value below the prediabetes range excludes prediabetes from controls (provisional; ADA cut-points from secondary summaries). |
| `phenotype.control_sampling` | method_decision | ADR-002: matched on visit type and calendar year, 2 controls per case (provisional, V-20). |
| `phenotype.label_defining_concepts` | documentation_derived | FR-135 initial list: diabetes diagnoses, HbA1c, glucose, diabetes medications; plus type 1/other diabetes (exclusion evidence). |
| `phenotype.min_observation_history` | method_decision | 365 days of history before index for cases and controls (provisional; V-11 pending for observation periods). |
| `prohibited` | method_decision | V-24 review in docs/features.md: complications, glucose monitoring, and diabetes education are excluded as indirect label revealers. |
| `temporal_policy.exclude_index_encounter` | method_decision | V-20 option C: exclude the diagnosing encounter. |
| `temporal_policy.lookback` | method_decision | Three years of lookback for features (provisional). |
| `temporal_policy.same_day` | method_decision | V-20 option B: exclude the index day (labs ordered with the diagnostic HbA1c, e.g. lipid/renal panels). |
| `temporal_policy.washout` | method_decision | No washout initially; the visit-bias check measures residual workup leakage. |
